test_stimuli.name: ch0_full_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: stream bytes: [0x00, 0xFF, 0xC0]. high_byte = 0xFF, low_byte = 0xC0. raw = ((0xFF & 0x03) << 8) | 0xC0 = (0x03 << 8) | 0xC0 = 0x300 | 0xC0 = 0x3C0 = 960. Wait, that's not 1023. Need raw=1023: high_byte bits [1:0] = 0x03, low_byte = 0xFF. So high_byte = 0x80 | 0x03 = 0x83, low_byte = 0xFF. stream: [0x00, 0x83, 0xFF]. raw = ((0x83 & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x300 | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023.
